scope.selection: correction-jobs-04 first 8 only, plus parent-requested back-mount v3 revision
scope.excluded: The other 19 correction jobs and fundamental-pose jobs; no registry/public/app/DB/history edits or promotion.

reviewBasis: PASS identifies a coherent static depiction, visible connected limbs and continuous garment ownership. It is not proof of dynamic outcome, pressure or every naturally occluded contact. Raw alpha files were viewed; no live app charcoal-composition or deployment approval claimed.

items.name: 플라잉 암바
items.specSingleChange: Move ONLY the two existing BLUE hands to enclose the SAME dangling WHITE wrist and lower forearm. Keep that one controlled WHITE arm collected between the existing blue thighs, with its elbow at the blue hip line; do not add another hand or arm.
specPreserve: Standing WHITE two-foot base
Exactly two attached BLUE legs crossing the head and upper chest
Airborne body angle, camera, faces, brown belts and rendering
items.reason: 두 파란 손이 이제 같은 늘어진 흰 손목·아래 전완을 잡고, 같은 팔이 파란 두 다리 사이에 모입니다. 선 흰색의 두 발 지지와 공중의 파란 머리·상체 제어 다리 관계가 유지됩니다.
keyChecks: Both blue hands control the same white wrist/lower forearm.
The same white arm remains collected between the blue thighs in the airborne armbar relationship.
Standing white base and two continuous blue leg routes remain coherent.
items.sourceLimit: Static visible technique identity only; natural nonessential occlusion is retained.

items.name: 브라보 초크
items.specSingleChange: Recolor ONLY the large released jacket/lapel panel surrounding the lower BLUE torso to the same BLUE as that athlete's jacket, keeping its current folds, grip and continuous jacket origin.
specPreserve: Exact bodies, camera and lapel-based Brabo arrangement
All four arm and leg routes
White top athlete and existing gripping hand positions
items.reason: 하부 파란 몸통에서 풀려 나온 큰 도복·라펠 패널이 파란색으로 이어져 소속이 분명해졌고, 목 근처의 라펠 제어와 기존 브라보 초크 배치는 유지됩니다.
keyChecks: Released lapel panel remains continuously BLUE from the bottom jacket.
White top maintains the visible lapel-based neck-control arrangement.
No extra limb or mixed sleeve/trouser ownership is evident.
items.sourceLimit: Static visible technique identity only; natural nonessential occlusion is retained.

items.name: 노스 사우스 초크
items.specSingleChange: Recolor ONLY both trouser legs of the black-haired top athlete WHITE and both trouser legs of the white-haired bottom athlete BLUE, tracing each existing hip-to-foot route without moving it.
specPreserve: Exact north-south geometry and camera
Neck loop and every hand placement
Faces, hair, brown belts, cloth shading and existing two-leg silhouettes
items.reason: 검은 머리 상부 주체의 두 바지가 흰색이고 하부 흰 머리 주체는 파란색으로 이어집니다. 서로 반대 길이 방향인 남북 배치와 머리·목을 감싸는 팔 고리가 유지됩니다.
keyChecks: White torso continues into WHITE trouser legs and blue torso into BLUE trouser sections.
Opposite lengthwise north-south body relationship is preserved.
The neck loop remains coherent; hidden or off-canvas distal leg details are not newly inferred.
items.sourceLimit: Far blue lower legs and a small white-foot edge extend beyond the canvas. This is a technical/static-pose PASS, not a full-body framing or app-render approval.

items.name: 바이셉 슬라이서
items.specSingleChange: Remove ONLY the duplicated WHITE sleeve/hand endpoint in the central folded-arm loop. Redraw that target as one continuous WHITE upper arm, ONE elbow crease, ONE forearm and ONE hand, folded around the existing BLUE forearm wedge. Keep the white athlete's separate other arm posted on the mat.
specPreserve: Both torso and lower-body positions and camera
One continuous BLUE forearm as elbow-crease wedge and BLUE securing hand
Faces, hair, brown belts and clothing style
items.reason: 중앙의 흰 팔은 한 상완-팔꿈치-전완 경로로 이어지고 중복 손·소매 끝이 제거됐습니다. 파란 전완을 팔꿈치 안쪽 받침으로 두고 접힌 팔을 고정하는 구조와 흰색의 반대 지지 팔이 구분됩니다.
keyChecks: One continuous white target arm folds around the existing blue forearm wedge.
Blue securing hand/forearm remain coherent without a duplicated white sleeve endpoint.
White other arm remains separately posted on the mat.
items.sourceLimit: Static visible technique identity only; natural nonessential occlusion is retained.

items.name: 새들 포지션
items.specSingleChange: Repair ONLY trouser ownership in the central entanglement: follow each existing hip-knee-cuff-foot route, recoloring each segment entirely WHITE for the black-haired athlete and entirely BLUE for the white-haired athlete. In particular, a BLUE cuff must continue into a BLUE shin and thigh. Do not alter the existing inside-triangle route or add a leg.
specPreserve: Exact reclined body layout, camera and existing four-leg geometry
Inside saddle connection around one partner thigh
Partner's separate far leg, all hands, faces and brown belts

keyChecks: The reclined inside-saddle relationship is recognizable.
The central blue cuff must continue through its own shin in BLUE.
Do not alter the partner separate white leg or add another limb.
items.sourceLimit: Static visible technique identity only; natural nonessential occlusion is retained.

Preserve the newly corrected blue knee panel, the captured partner WHITE leg, the separate raised WHITE leg, all four-leg geometry, hands and faces. items.name: 웨이터 스윕
items.specSingleChange: Recolor the vertically raised lifting leg that comes from the BOTTOM BLUE pelvis to BLUE continuously through its thigh, knee and cuff. Keep the upper partner's two own legs WHITE. Do not move or duplicate a leg.
specPreserve: Loaded waiter body arrangement and exact camera
Captured WHITE partner leg and the remaining WHITE base
Sleeve block, hand placement, faces, brown belts and cloth texture
items.reason: 하단 파란 골반에서 올라가는 들어 올린 다리가 허벅지·무릎·커프까지 파란색으로 이어지고, 위 흰 주체의 두 다리와 분리됩니다. 웨이터의 하중을 싣는 몸 관계와 손·소매 블록은 유지됩니다.
keyChecks: The raised lifting leg continues from the BLUE bottom pelvis in BLUE throughout.
The WHITE partner two leg routes remain separate.
Loaded waiter relationship and continuous visible limb ownership remain coherent.
items.sourceLimit: Static loaded-sweep depiction only; dynamic sweep success and naturally hidden ankle details are not inferred.

revisionReviews.reason: v2에 생겼던 세 번째 파란 다리는 사라졌고 파란 두 다리와 각 도복 소속이 일관됩니다. 흰 가까운 다리가 파란 골반·상부 허벅지 쪽으로 모인 상태에서 등 뒤 밀착과 백마운트 정체성이 읽힙니다. 몸 아래에 가려진 흰 발등을 새로 보인다고 주장하지 않습니다.
keyChecks: Exactly two blue legs remain, preserving continuous hip-to-knee-to-foot ownership.
White torso remains attached chest-to-back with the near white leg drawn toward the blue hip/upper-thigh region.
Naturally hidden white feet are not forced into view or counted as absent anatomy.
revisionReviews.sourceLimit: The exact white instep contact remains naturally partly occluded. This PASS is static technique identity and visible anatomy, not proof of every hidden hook or dynamic control.

keyChecks: Central horizontal trouser band continues from the BLUE cuff in BLUE.
The separate diagonal and raised WHITE leg routes remain white.
Existing inside-saddle four-leg arrangement, hands and identities remain coherent.
revisionReviews.sourceLimit: Static visible technique identity and garment continuity; no dynamic result, pressure or newly inferred hidden contact.
